description: Minimal permissions for the launcher's own webview (label=main). Scoped by 'webviews', NOT 'windows': a matching 'windows' pattern enables the capability on every webview inside that window, which would hand core:* to the embedded DSH page (label=dsh, an untrusted http://127.0.0.1 origin). Never add that webview here and never add a 'remote' block for it.
